overview.en:
Review crypto bots, balances, screeners and backtests with Gainium’s official OAuth connections, with a separate trading connection.

Review connected trading bots, balances, and backtest results before changing a strategy. Keep historical simulation results separate from live trading outcomes.

Complete the connection or local-runtime setup described by this plugin before using service tools. Results depend on the tools exposed to your account; specify the target resource and report scope when starting a task.
overview.zh-CN:
通过 Gainium 官方 OAuth 连接查看加密交易机器人、余额、筛选器与回测，并可单独连接交易服务。

在调整策略前查看已连接的交易机器人、余额与回测结果，区分历史模拟结果与实盘表现。

使用服务工具前，按插件说明完成连接或本地运行环境配置。结果取决于账号可用工具；开始任务时请说明目标资源与报告范围。

starterPrompts.en: Summarize my connected trading bots and their current status.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 汇总我已连接的交易机器人及当前状态。

starterPrompts.en: Compare these two backtests and explain their assumptions.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 比较这两次回测，并解释各自的假设。

starterPrompts.en: Review the available market screener results for this strategy.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 查看适用于这个策略的市场筛选结果。
